reply: The document states that treason consists only in levying war against the United States or adhering to their enemies and giving them aid and comfort, [1] and requires conviction on the testimony of two witnesses to an overt act or a confession in open court. No attainder of treason shall work corruption of blood or forfeiture except during the life of the person attainted, while all citizens are entitled to full faith and credit for public acts between states and must be delivered up if they flee justice [1][2].
